module: "Driver abstract" screen accessible from the garage computer in career. It adds an entry to the computer menu and provides the UI with the data computed by the insurance module (career_modules_insurance_insurance.getPlayerAbstractData).
notes: The computer function is disabled until the starter vehicle is bought (reasons.hasBoughtStarterVehicle).
The menu only opens via navigate if an originating computer id is provided.

openPlayerAbstractMenu.desc: Remembers the originating computer and, if it exists, navigates to career.computer.playerAbstract then triggers the onComputerPlayerAbstract hook.

closePlayerAbstractMenu.desc: Returns to the originating computer's menu, or closes all career menus if there is none.

getPlayerAbstractData.desc: Returns the driver abstract data provided by the insurance module.

sendPlayerAbstractDataToUI.desc: Pushes fresh data to an already open screen (guihooks playerAbstractData), e.g. after a score reset.

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Computer hook: adds the playerAbstract function (order 15, category general) if the facility allows it.

onRouteMount.desc: UI router lifecycle: places the abstract data in data.playerAbstract.

onRouteLeave.desc: UI router lifecycle: forgets the originating computer when leaving the screen.
